name: Concord Parks & Recreation Traditional Summer Camps (Stay & Play, Rec Adventure, Adventure)
operator_name: Concord Parks & Recreation (City of Concord, NH)
description_short: City-run summer day camps for kids entering grades 1–8. Stay & Play (grades 1–5) is an 8-week camp at the City Wide Community Center and Keach Park, while Adventure (grades 3–5) and Teen Adventure (grades 6–8) take out-of-town trips Monday–Thursday and spend Fridays in town.
swim_waterfront_notes: Stay & Play includes swimming. Adventure camp trips include beach trips, kayaking and surfing. The page gives no details on supervision or swim testing.
